connector.name: The Mine Works
connector.registryDescription: 31 pay-per-result web data tools: LinkedIn, Google Maps, SEC, real estate, jobs, leads, gov data.
connector.summary: Hosted at the-mine-works-mcp.hatchable.site over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.themineworks, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your Apify API token as a bearer credential, e.g. 'Bearer apify_api_...'. Get one at https://console.apify.com/account/integrations. All actor runs bill to your own Apify account.
